purpose: Where Vendor Maps' vendors come from: one entry per public source. Read by pipeline/ (see pipeline/README.md). Rosters are added with python -m pipeline.add_rosters; the owner's directories are pulled from their public GitHub files.

sources.title: Ohio Cannabis Ecosystem Directory (organizations)
sources.kept_rule: Every business and nonprofit row except those flagged out of scope, individuals and political parties. OCHBS 2026 exhibitors keep the event; direct OCHBS contacts are marked trade-show-contact. Contact people, emails and phones are not read.

sources.title: Pennsylvania cannabis companies (from the cannabis directory)
sources.kept_rule: Every company row; the business-inquiry column (contacts) is never read.

sources.title: MJBizCon 2026 exhibitors that list Ohio (cannabis directory research file)
sources.publisher: Ohio Cannabis Ecosystem Directory research, from MJBizCon's official exhibitor profiles
sources.kept_rule: Every exhibitor in the file; headquarters city and state taken from the profile notes.
